segments.en: Hello.
Hello Raja ji.
Khushi ji, how are you?
Good name you have kept.
The name is wonderful.
Hmm.
Did you feel happy after hearing the name, Khushi ji?
Yes, yes, why wouldn't I be happy?
I am very happy.
Oh, you are happy.
And I felt happy hearing your name and your voice.
What do you do, Khushi ji?
Right now, I just do housework.
Housewife.
Housewife, are you married? When did it happen?
Yes, that is why I have become a wife.
You became a wife, a house wife. You are a house wife, not your husband's wife.
I am a house wife, yes, I am a house wife. Why do people get married if not for the house?
Hmm.
So, how many children do you have?
Just one, he is still small.
Okay, how many years of marriage?
It has been three years of marriage.
Okay.
Where does your husband live?
He lives with me, he is at the office right now.
He is at the office.
You know, you operate the app, the Friends app?
No, no, no, how can you say that? Such things...
Is the account yours or his? Whose is it?
I have linked my sister's account.
Oh, you linked your sister's account. So the money goes to her?
It goes to her, and she withdraws it and gives it to me via ATM.
Whenever I need it, when it becomes a large amount, she gives it all at once.
That is the thing.
Actually, it is not much, just 100-200 rupees.
It happens.
You are not very active, right?
Yes, that is the thing, I told you, there is a lot of housework.
There is a girl, I talked to her for an hour the other day.
She stays online from 7 AM to 12 AM.
Oh my god, really? She must be a girl, not married.
No, she is unmarried.
Yes, that is why I am saying, she must not be married.
She is very good, but she doesn't pick up calls, she gives them to others.
Oh, she must always be busy.
Always busy.
But she talks very wonderfully, whatever you talk about, good or bad.
Huh?
Whatever you talk about with her, it is all wonderful.
Okay, okay, yes, yes.
She must be open, that is the thing.
Open.
Hmm.
That is right.
No, I do not have time, I do not have any time to come online.
People ask me when I will come, when I will talk again, I cannot tell them.
I do not have any time.
Whenever I get time.
